items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This is (Sally Nonstead?) Johnston and I'm here in West Beth in New York with Gil Evans and his perfectly delightful wife Anita.

ctx.x: This is (Sally Nonstead?) Johnston and I'm here in West Beth in New York with Gil Evans and his perfectly delightful wife Anita.

........arranging, maybe you all know, didn't pay me any money. Because arranging, you don't get any royalties from arranging. And now for a short time after you know, we go for long periods of time with no income and this all has to do with the fact that I was always an arranger of other people's music. We get tired of it sometimes and some days.
